native.tokenUnits: Native points and Dynamic Type text styles; not CSS sizes or web previews.
native.colorPolicy: Dynamic semantic roles cannot be truthfully encoded as fixed CSS colors. No substituted hex colors or synthesized tonal ramps.

content-container.purpose: Opaque user/tool messages, permission panels and detail notices

accessible-control.purpose: Opaque glass-surface fallback under Reduce Transparency or increased contrast

material.accessibleSurface: Opaque grouped system background plus shape.stroke(.primary.opacity(0.2), lineWidth: 0.5); non-hit-testing outline
material.buttonBehavior: System styles own pressed, disabled, accessibility and destructive-role behavior; surface-modifier fallback is separate from button styling.
material.bottomAttachment: iOS 26 safeAreaBar(edge: .bottom, spacing: 0); earlier iOS safeAreaInset(edge: .bottom, spacing: 0)
material.scope: Controls only; system navigation/tab bars remain system-owned; no decorative shadows or custom glass simulation.

layout.adaptation: dynamicTypeSize.isAccessibilitySize stacks directory title/status, removes title truncation, moves delivery menu below controls and changes draft line limit from 1...6 to 1...3.
layout.accessory: Viewport-bounded scrollable bottom accessory; measured composer/header heights constrain permission panel; no authored fixed device breakpoint.
layout.touchTargets: Explicit minimum 44pt frames on key controls do not verify every native target on-device.

verification.basis: Saved source only; arm64 compile/link/package passed; source reviewer resolved both named findings.
verification.notCanonized: No visual finding is closed by documentation; runtime legibility, clipping and native material appearance remain unverified. Icon colors are artwork, not palette primitives.

headline.purpose: Directory titles and dialog headings; native navigation independently owns titles.

context.purpose: Location and supporting labels; medium weight where authored.

caption.purpose: Metadata and speaker labels; speaker labels use semibold.

status.purpose: Medium-weight text paired with a semantic SF Symbol.

send-symbol.purpose: SF Symbol arrow.up, replaced by progress while pending; not display text.

tool-content.purpose: Selectable monospaced tool output. Commands use body.monospaced(); terminal keys subheadline.monospaced().

motion.name: dictation-state
motion.purpose: Composer layout changes on dictation.state; nil when accessibilityReduceMotion is true.

motion.name: state-symbol
motion.purpose: Status/dictation state changes only, suppressed by a constant trigger under Reduce Motion; no ambient loops.

motion.name: native-feedback
motion.purpose: Selection on tab/pane changes; success only after agent.prompt host acknowledgment. Haptic feedback, not visual delivery proof.

components.name: Primary native action
components.description: Prominent glass on iOS 26, borderedProminent earlier; large capsules for setup, circle for Send, with system states.
components.nativeEvidence: MobileGlassStyle.swift: mobileGlassButtonStyle(prominent: true); GlobalAgentsView.swift setup; AgentConversationView.swift Send

components.name: Secondary native action
components.description: Glass capsule permission/reconnect/terminal actions, bordered earlier; host labels and disabled state retained.

components.name: Editable floating composer
components.description: Plain multiline field inside a continuous glass surface, beside separate Send; borderless commands/dictation and accessible line/menu adaptation.

components.name: Agent status capsule
components.description: Text plus SF Symbol; 5pt internal gap; state-color opacity 0.1 or 0.2 under increased contrast. Unknown/cached never ready.

components.name: Tool disclosure
components.description: Selectable monospaced output in opaque secondary system background; native DisclosureGroup, error symbol/text state.

components.name: User transcript message
components.description: Opaque secondary system surface with real speaker label; assistant text stays directly on transcript background.

components.name: Permission panel
components.description: Opaque clipped scrollable panel, prompt disclosure, optional rounded-border response field and separate glass action buttons; host owns outcomes.

components.name: Agent directory row
components.description: Opaque inset-grouped list row with headline, context, capsule status and explicit cached notice; title/status stack at accessibility sizes.

components.name: System navigation
components.description: Unchanged Agents/Machines/Settings tabs, native stacks/back gestures, segmented pane views and real-page review sheet; no HTML/CSS preview.

narrative.overview:
This is a source-derived native system, **not a visually verified design**. The user chose native iOS rather than a browser-shaped terminal application. SwiftUI platform controls carry the interface; the actual Plannotator page and SwiftTerm renderer retain their own content presentation.

The approved Apple Liquid Glass refresh adds a prettier, more magical native control layer without replacing the Operate identity or navigation. Surface-specific direction remains in [docs/IOS_SURFACE.md](docs/IOS_SURFACE.md).
keyCharacteristics: System-owned navigation, semantic colors and Dynamic Type.
Floating glass controls over opaque, readable content.
Explicit actions and state-driven feedback, never ambient animation.

rules.name: The Semantic State Rule
rules.body: Status always has text and an SF Symbol, never color alone; cached/unknown agents cannot appear ready. Appearance follows the system. The icon's fixed colors are artwork, not UI palette tokens.

rules.name: The Native Type Rule
rules.body: Keep system text styles and SF Symbols; no custom display face. Accessibility-size rows stack title/status and remove title truncation. Draft lines and delivery-menu placement adapt to text size; actual clipping remains unverified.

rules.name: The Controls-Only Glass Rule
rules.body: Apple's iOS 26 `.glassEffect(.regular, in:)`, `.glass` and `.glassProminent` belong to controls; transcript, directory content and permission explanations stay opaque. System navigation/tab bars adopt native glass without custom replacements. `GlassEffectContainer(spacing: 8)` shares rendering across adjacent controls without merging their resting shapes.

rules.name: The State-Only Motion Rule
rules.body: Dictation changes use `.smooth(duration: 0.25)` unless Reduce Motion is enabled; status/dictation symbol bounces are state-triggered and suppressed under Reduce Motion. Selection haptics follow native tab/pane changes; success feedback follows the host acknowledgment. Navigation pushes/sheets remain system transitions. Streaming text is not animated; no ambient loops or custom entrance choreography.

dos: Do preserve platform navigation, semantic colors, Dynamic Type and SF Symbols.
Do keep glass on controls, content opaque and accessibility fallbacks native.
Do distinguish unknown/unreachable state from a verified empty directory.
Do tie motion to state, honor Reduce Motion and await host acknowledgment for success feedback.
Do capture native screenshots in both appearances, keyboard/landscape and large text sizes before claiming visual readiness.
donts: Don't use browser screenshots, fake HTML/CSS glass or mock conversations as evidence of the native app.
Don't substitute fixed hex palettes for dynamic system colors or UI tokens for icon artwork.
Don't add decorative dashboard metrics, ambient animation, custom navigation gestures or notification controls.
Don't treat compilation or resolved source findings as a visual verdict.
